notes.title: Bug hunting!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]
I'm Jenny (Robohamster), the creator of "The ordinary case of Margaret Luoni". I'm a solo developer so I really need your help testing the game!
 Please let me know if you find any bugs or issues with the game. So far, only 1 scene is ready, but the whole game will be ready very soon. If you have any suggestions or interesting ideas - write, I will be happy to listen. You can write to me here or by email.
On this link, you can find all my contacts
[url=https://www.robohamster.xyz/links]Robohamster.xyz[/url]
